legend: Boy Dima gave Julian a birthday present — set B$$$B$$$ consisting of positive integers. However, he didn't know, that Julian hates sets, but enjoys bipartite graphs more than anything else!

Julian was almost upset, but her friend Alex said, that he can build an undirected graph using this set in such a way: let all integer numbers be vertices, then connect any two i$$$i$$$ and j$$$j$$$ with an edge if |i−j|$$$|i - j|$$$ belongs to B$$$B$$$.

Unfortunately, Julian doesn't like the graph, that was built using B$$$B$$$. Alex decided to rectify the situation, so he wants to erase some numbers from B$$$B$$$, so that graph built using the new set is bipartite. The difficulty of this task is that the graph, Alex has to work with, has an infinite number of vertices and edges! It is impossible to solve this task alone, so Alex asks you for help. Write a program that erases a subset of minimum size from B$$$B$$$ so that graph constructed on the new set is bipartite.
Recall, that graph is bipartite if all its vertices can be divided into two disjoint sets such that every edge connects a vertex from different sets.
input: First line contains an integer n (1⩽n⩽200000)$$$n ~ (1 \leqslant n \leqslant 200\,000)$$$ — size of B$$$B$$$
Second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers b1,b2,…,bn (1⩽bi⩽1018)$$$b_1, b_2, \ldots, b_n ~ (1 \leqslant b_i \leqslant 10^{18})$$$ — numbers of B$$$B$$$, all bi$$$b_i$$$ are unique
output: In the first line print single integer k$$$k$$$ – the number of erased elements. In the second line print k$$$k$$$ integers — values of erased elements.
If there are multiple answers, print any of them.

legend.ai: Dima 男孩送给 Julian 一份生日礼物——由正整数构成的集合 B$$$B$$$。然而，他不知道 Julian 讨厌集合，而最喜欢二分图！
Julian 差点就要沮丧了，但他的朋友 Alex 说，他可以利用这个集合构造一个无向图，具体如下：令所有整数都是顶点，如果 |i−j|$$$|i - j|$$$ 属于 B$$$B$$$，就在任意两个 i$$$i$$$ 和 j$$$j$$$ 之间连一条边。
遗憾的是，Julian 不喜欢使用 B$$$B$$$ 构建的图。Alex 决定解决这个问题，因此他想从 B$$$B$$$ 中删除一些数，使得使用新集合构建的图是二分图。这个任务的难点在于，Alex 需要处理的图拥有无限多个顶点和边！独自解决这个任务是不可能的，因此 Alex 向你寻求帮助。请编写一个程序，从 B$$$B$$$ 中删除一个大小最小的子集，使得在新集合上构建的图是二分图。
回忆一下，如果图中的所有顶点都能被划分为两个不相交的集合，使得每条边都连接来自不同集合的两个顶点，那么这个图就是二分图。
